summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the presentation of new preclinical data for its cytomegalovirus vaccine candidate EVX-V1 at the International Herpesvirus Workshop. The filing is a routine disclosure by a foreign private issuer of a scientific conference presentation. No corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return is involved. The filing provides no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. This is a standard operational update without special-situation implications.
